<DOCSTRING>
Creates a state space tree to explore all possible branches using depth-first search (DFS).

Args:
    nums (list[int]): The list of numbers to explore.
    max_sum (int): The maximum sum allowed for any branch.
    num_index (int): The current index in the nums list.
    path (list[int]): The current path of numbers selected.
    result (list[list[int]]): The list to store all valid paths.
    remaining_nums_sum (int): The remaining sum of numbers not yet considered.

Returns:
    None: This function modifies the result list in place.
</DOCSTRING>
